properties.name: The tools the call log shows are step-only are listed under their process tool, not at the top level, and stay callable by name
properties.source: integrated-flo's accepted process-step decision (2026-10-25, "d then b"): this is its b step, on the d measurement
properties.statement: The tool listing shows each tool the call log measured as STEP-ONLY under the process tool it is a step of, not among the top-level tools, and every one stays callable by its own name with its schema unchanged. Measured 2026-10-30 (fact:the-served-tools-sorted-by-their-counts-109-used-5-cued-unfollowed-40-never-reached-6-steps-39-close-2026-10-30): mint_seat under claim_region (38 of 38 runs right before it, none alone); satisfies under add_capability (42 of 54 within two writes, none alone; add_capability already takes `satisfies`); relation_candidates under review_relations (70 of 80, 1 alone); consumes and provides together, beside add_interface (14 of 17 and 16 of 18 next to each other, none alone). NOT listed under another tool, because the log shows them used alone: set_artifact_checksums (29 of 327 runs alone: re-accepting after a re-pin), set_capability_status (43% next to replace_text), move_component (5 runs, never next to a constructor). The list is re-measured at the 90-day usage re-run (about 2026-12-23) before it is applied, and a tool moves under a process only on that measurement.
